plainText:
Pokémon Move Specialist Professor Kukui (Japanese: 研究！！技の博士・ククイ！ Research!! The of Moves - Kukui!) is the third chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
delivers and to Professor Kukui.
Moon gives Rotom to Professor Kukui.
Professor Kukui reveals he needed a Rotom to have it combine with the Pokédex he gave to Sun.
Due to Sun's mishandling of the Pokédex, Rotom refuses to enter the device.
The island kahunas plan to host a tournament at a festival to determine who will travel the islands and calm the Guardian deities.
Professor Kukui enters Sun in the festival.
